notes.help_text:
📝 *IMIYALO YEMINININGWANE*

*Yengeza umniningwane:*
{{prefix}}addnote <umbhalo>
{{prefix}}newnote <umbhalo>
{{prefix}}makenote <umbhalo>

*Thola umniningwane othile:*
{{prefix}}getnote <inombolo>
{{prefix}}listnote <inombolo>

*Thola yonke iminingwane yakho:*
{{prefix}}getnotes
{{prefix}}getallnotes
{{prefix}}listnotes

*Buyekeza umniningwane:*
{{prefix}}updatenote <inombolo> <umbhalo omusha>

*Susa umniningwane othile:*
{{prefix}}delnote <inombolo>
{{prefix}}deletenote <inombolo>
{{prefix}}removenote <inombolo>

*Susa yonke iminingwane yakho:*
{{prefix}}delallnotes
{{prefix}}removeallnotes
{{prefix}}deleteallnotes

_Iminingwane iyimfihlo futhi igcinwa ngokuphephile kudathabhesi._

settings.antiedit_options:
❌ Sicela ukhethe: *on*, *off*, *indm* (i-DM kuphela), noma *inchat* (engxoxweni kuphela)

*Amanani asebenzayo amanje:*
• *indm* - Isexwayiso ku-DM yomnikazi kuphela (okuzenzakalelayo)
• *inchat* - Isexwayiso kuleyo ngxoxo kuphela
• *on* - Isexwayiso ku-DM nasengxoxweni
• *off* - Vala i-anti-edit

badwords.menu:
📋 *Ukuphathwa Kwamagama Amabi*

*Ukusetshenziswa:*
• *.badwords add <igama>* - Engeza igama elibi
• *.badwords add <igama1> <igama2>* - Engeza amagama amaningi
• *.badwords remove <igama>* - Susa igama
• *.badwords list* - Bonisa wonke amagama amabi
• *.badwords clear* - Susa wonke amagama amabi
• *.badwords default* - Layisha amagama amabi angokwenhloso ({{defaultCount}})

*Uhlu lwamanje ({{count}}):*
{{list}}
